Package theknife.obj.review

Class Review

java.lang.Object
theknife.obj.review.Review
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class Review extends Object implements Serializable
A class representing a review with content, rating, and an associated response.

This class allows you to store a review consisting of a textual content and a numerical rating.
It also stores a Response to the review.

Author:
Damiano De Mutiis 761348 (CO), Matteo Porto Bonacci 761396 (CO), Matteo Monticone 761701 (CO), Mattia Tamburo 760743 (CO)
